report.summary: Transaction alerts were delayed due to an external vendor latency degradation at sms-vendor, which experienced a p99 latency anomaly starting at 14:05 on 2026-10-12. This caused synchronous outbound requests from notification-service to block, backing up asynchronous message consumption from the event-bus and resulting in consumer lag starting at 14:07.

ranked_hypotheses.title: External Vendor Latency Degradation in SMS and Push Providers

supporting.note: Shows outbound requests to sms-vendor taking over 5.5 seconds starting at 14:02.
Confirms sms-vendor p99 latency anomaly starting at 14:05, peaking at 1569.0 ms.
Shows outbound requests to push-provider taking over 7.2 seconds starting at 14:06.
Shows consumer lag increasing sharply starting at 14:07, peaking at over 1000 messages.
Confirms warning logs for consumer group notif-alerts lag starting at 14:18.
Past incident shares exact symptom and root-cause category of sms-vendor delays.

contradicting.note: sms-vendor error rate showed no anomalous behavior during the window.
sms-vendor request rate remained stable with no traffic surge.
sms-vendor experienced its own p99 latency anomaly starting at 14:05, indicating the bottleneck was vendor-side.
Outbound call logs show vendor-side latency rather than client-side connection exhaustion.

supporting.note: A config change (credentials rotation) was executed on notification-service earlier in the day at 07:38.

contradicting.note: The time gap between the change at 07:38 and the symptom onset at 14:02 is over 6 hours, with successful operation in between.
notification-service successfully processed payment intents and other requests normally hours after the change.

facts.text: Metrics queries for notification-service failed with a 503 Service Unavailable error.
Event-bus consumer_lag metric showed an upward anomaly starting at 2026-10-12T14:07:00+00:00, peaking at 1006.69 messages at 14:33:00+00:00.
Event-bus request rate, error rate, p99 latency, and CPU usage remained stable and showed no anomalies.
Notification-service logged slow outbound requests to sms-vendor starting at 2026-10-12T14:02:53+00:00.
Notification-service logged slow outbound requests to push-provider starting at 2026-10-12T14:06:19+00:00.
Notification-service logged consumer group notif-alerts lag warnings starting at 2026-10-12T14:18:26+00:00.
notification-service consumes messages asynchronously from event-bus and makes synchronous calls to sms-vendor and push-provider.
payments-api produces messages asynchronously to event-bus.
notification-service underwent a scheduled API credentials rotation (chg-9140) at 2026-10-12T07:38:00+00:00, prior to the reported symptom onset around 14:00.
sms-vendor latency_p99_ms experienced an anomaly starting at 2026-10-12T14:05:00+00:00, reaching a peak of 1569.0 ms at that time.
sms-vendor request rate and error rate percentage showed no anomalous behavior in the observation window.
push-provider metrics (rps, error_rate_pct, latency_p99_ms) showed no anomalies throughout the 12:00 to 14:40 window.

assumptions: sms-vendor and push-provider suffered internal capacity or routing degradation outside of our platform control.

recommended_actions.action: Implement asynchronous timeout and circuit breaking on notification-service outbound calls to sms-vendor and push-provider to prevent worker thread blocking and consumer lag propagation.
recommended_actions.rationale: Synchronous waits on slow external vendor APIs directly block workers and cascade into event-bus consumer lag.

recommended_actions.action: Establish vendor SLA monitoring and alerting for sms-vendor p99 latency spikes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Early detection of external provider latency degradation will help pinpoint transaction notification delays faster.

recommended_actions.action: Investigate and resolve the 503 query failures on the notification-service metrics backend to ensure complete observability during future incidents.
recommended_actions.rationale: Tool failures and missing direct telemetry forced reliance on indirect evidence during the investigation.
